Kaveri Mercantile Bank 
 Guarantee & Bond Department
 
 PERFORMANCE BANK GUARANTEE 
 
 Non-Judicial Stamp Paper - Value: INR 100/- 
 
 Bond No: BND-00059 Issue Date: 2020-04-19
 
 IRREVOCABLE AND UNCONDITIONAL 
 To: 
 The Managing Director / Executive Director 
 The Employer / Commissioner 
 India 
 
 Subject: Performance Bank Guarantee for Performance Bond - Tender Ref: RFP-132006111
 Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
 WHEREAS National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (hereinafter called the "Contractor/Principal") has submitted a bid vide Tender
 Reference RFP-132006111 dated 2020-04-19 for the work of Sewerage Drainage Works, and
 WHEREAS as a condition precedent for the award of the contract, the Contractor is required to furnish a Performance Bank Guarantee
 for 5% (five percent) of the contract value, and 
 
 WHEREAS the Contractor has requested Kaveri Mercantile Bank (hereinafter called the "Guarantor") to issue this Performance Bank
 Guarantee in your favour. 
 NOW THEREFORE, we, Kaveri Mercantile Bank, do hereby irrevocably and unconditionally guarantee to pay to you, on first written
 
 demand without protest or demur, an amount not exceeding Rs. 177.57 Lakh (Rupees 1.78 Crore Only), being Performance Bond
 amount, subject to the following terms: 
 
 TERMS AND CONDITIONS 
 1. Liability: Our total liability under this Bank Guarantee shall not exceed Rs. 177.57 Lakh (India Rupees Rupees 1.78 Crore
 Only). 
 
 2. Validity: This Guarantee shall remain valid from 2020-04-19 until 2023-01-30 (the "Expiry Date") unless extended by
 mutual consent in writing. 
 3. Claim Period: We shall be liable to pay under this guarantee only if a written claim or demand is served upon us on or
 before the Expiry Date. 
 4. Enforceability: Any claim arising under this guarantee shall be enforceable at our branch office at Mumbai or at any
 scheduled bank branch in India as nominated by the claimant. 
 
 5. No Defence: Our obligation to pay is absolute and unconditional. We shall have no right of set-off, counterclaim, or
 defence arising from any dispute between the Contractor and the Employer.
 6. Modification: This guarantee shall not be affected by any change in the constitution, ownership, or control of the
 Contractor or the Employer. 
 7. Governing Law: This guarantee is governed by the laws of India and is subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of courts in
 
 Mumbai. 
 BANK DETAILS 
 
 
 Guarantor Bank Kaveri Mercantile Bank 
 Branch Corporate Branch, Mumbai 
 
 IFSC Code KNBX0004417

 Acknowledgement by the Contractor 
 
 I/We, National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd., hereby acknowledge receipt of this Performance Bank Guarantee and confirm that the terms

 Director 
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd.

 Instructions to Bank (on expiry) 
 Bank should note that on expiry of the Bond Period, the Original Bond will not be returned to the Bank. The Bank is requested to take appropriate action on or after
